condition.narrative: Should contribute directly to results for children as outlined in the UNDAF, national results and/or UNICEF Strategic Plan and within the scope defined in the CPD, CPAP, OMP or other agreed upon programme documents

title.narrative: UNICEF provided technical support to the Ministry of Health in the institutionalization of WASH and Infection Prevention Control (IPC) in Health Care Facilities (HCF), including the development of national standards, the preparation of action plans , and a monitoring framework, as well as the integration of WASH and IPC into the DHIS2 platform.
Existence of an integrated humanitarian-development-peace nexus approach to WASH programming through the participation of affected populations
Extent to which a climate rationale for the impact of climate change and water scarcity on WASH services has been developed
Extent to which national and local government frameworks for preparedness and/or early/anticipatory action are updated to be and child sensitive at the national and local levels

Extent to which child-sensitive programmes enhance the climate and disaster resiliene of children, reduce environmental degradation and promote low carbon development and environmental sustainability with UNICEF support
Existence of functioning cluster coordination mechanism for water, sanitation and hygiene in humanitarian situations, Text
